meaning: `defined_by = :Ptm` is the default switch for how a vessel's compliance law is parameterised — transmural pressure rather than an alternative formulation. Every vessel built with GenericVessel_Compliance that does not pass `defined_by` explicitly inherits this law and its Ptm-branch parameters.

could_move.what: Compliance law used by m6 vessels that omit defined_by, hence m6 pressure/volume traces
Resistance-evolution branch consuming the same component (dR/dV)
Model-comparison figures pairing m5 and m6, since both copies carry the same default
Patient-fit deck outputs for m5, whose Elements.jl has the identical default
Fitting report figures built from the patient decks

expectation: unknown. Changing the default would alter compliance and the dR/dV coupling for any vessel relying on it, so waveforms and fitted parameters could shift. Direction and size cannot be inferred here.

check.why: Shows which call sites pass defined_by explicitly and which fall back to the default, so the true blast radius is known before any solve or re-fit.
